questions.question:
Which of the following statements is correct?

I. Death rate in India is 7.1 per 1000 in 2011.

II. Life expectancy at birth is 72.6 years in 2012.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• With the government's efforts, the death rates have declined from **25 per 1000 population in 1951 to 7.1 per 1000 in 2011** life expectancy at birth has increased from **36.7 years in 1951 to 67.9 years in 2012.**
 
• According to the **2011 census** in** India, **the life expectancy at birth was approximately **65.5 years**.

questions.question: As per the Census-2011, the total absolute increase in population during the decade is ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**18.19 crore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the Census-2011, the total absolute increase in population during the decade is **18.19 crore**.
 
• The Census of India, conducted every ten years, is the most comprehensive source of demographic data in the country.
 
• The 2011 Census was the 15th National census since 1871 and the 7th after independence.
 
• It provides critical data that helps in planning and policy-making for the government.
 
• The census data is used to allocate resources, plan for infrastructure development, and implement social programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Census-2011 was conducted in two phases: the House Listing and Housing Census phase and the Population Enumeration phase.
 
• India's population as per the 2011 Census was approximately 1.21 billion.
 
• The Census-2011 also included data on literacy rates, sex ratio, urbanization, and more.
 
• The data from the census is essential for understanding demographic changes and trends over time.
 
• It helps in identifying areas that need more attention and resources for development and welfare programs.

questions.question: The literacy rate of Andhra Pradesh state as per the Census of 2011 is _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**67.02%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• With a **literacy rate** of approximately** 67.02%**, it suggests that out of every 100 individuals aged seven and above in Andhra Pradesh, about 67 were literate, meaning they possessed the ability to read and write with understanding.
 
• Andhra Pradesh's population, according to data from the 2011 Census, is 8.46 crore, up from 7.62 crore in the 2001 Census. As to the latest census data, Andhra Pradesh has a total population of 84,580,777, with 42,442,146 males and 42,138,631 females, respectively.
 
• Andhra Pradesh has a lower sex ratio than the national average of 940, with 993 females for every 1000 males, according to the most recent census. In Andhra Pradesh in 2001, there were 978 females for every 1000 males. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the **2011 Indian Census, Andhra Pradesh's literacy rate** is the proportion of the state's population that is seven years of age or older and can read and write in any language with comprehension.
 
• According to the **2011 census, 74.04% of Indians are literate**. Male literacy rates are 82.14% while female literacy rates are 65.46%.

• Crude Death Rate (CDR) is the number of deaths per 1,000 population in a given year. It is a measure of mortality in a population.

questions.question: Which of the following is the most literate district in India as per Census 2011?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Serchhip.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A person aged seven and above, who can both read and write with understanding in any language, is treated as literate.
 
• **Serchhip**__ was the most literate district in India as per Census 2011.
 
• Serchhip is a city in the Indian state of** Mizoram.**
 
• As per census data in 2011, the average literacy rate in Serchhip district was **98.23 %.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **According to the 2011 census**:

 
 
• The national literacy rate in the country is** 74.04%.**
 
• The literacy rate among males is **82.14%.**
 
• The literacy rate among females is **65.46%.**
 
• **Kerala** retained the top with a **93.91%** literacy rate.
 
• **Bihar** ranks the last in the overall ranking with a** 63.8%** literacy rate.
 
• **Serchip** in Mizoram is the most literate district in India.
 
• **Alirajpur** in Madhya Pradesh is the least literate district in India.
 
• **Lakshadweep** is the most literate union territory in India with a **91.85%** literacy rate.
 
• **Dadra Nagar Haveli **is the least literate union territory in India with a 76.24% literacy rate.

questions.question: According the Census of India 2011, which group of states has the least urban population?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh and Bihar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, **Himachal Pradesh and Bihar** have the least urban population among the listed options.
 
• Himachal Pradesh has a predominantly rural population with a small percentage living in urban areas.
 
• Bihar also has a high rural population with lower urbanization compared to many other states in India.
 
• The urban population percentage is a crucial factor in determining the level of urbanization in these states.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Census of India** is conducted every ten years to collect demographic data, including information on urban and rural populations.
 
• The 2011 Census provided detailed insights into the population distribution, literacy rates, and other socio-economic parameters across different states and union territories.
 
• Urbanization is an important aspect of economic development and is often associated with better infrastructure, healthcare, and educational facilities.
 
• States with lower urban populations may face challenges related to rural development, including access to basic amenities and services.
 
• Efforts are often made by both central and state governments to improve urbanization rates and develop rural areas simultaneously.

questions.question: According to Census of India 2011, what is the decadal population growth rate?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**17.7%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Decadal population growth rate** refers to the percentage increase in the **population** over a period of **ten years.**
 
• The Census of India is conducted **every ten years **to gather** demographic and socio-economic data** about the population of India.
